entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: About those Phantom Thieves, I mean.[n]If Dad were still alive...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Sorry, I... I shouldn't bring this up[n]while we're eating.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I just wonder if he would've been on[n]their side... That's all...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: The only reason you have time to think[n]about that is because you depend on[n]someone else.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: You don't have to do a single thing,[n]and you're provided with food, clothes,[n]a home...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I've had no time to think on such[n]ridiculous thoughts.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Would Dad have been happy with them?[n]I don't care.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: He died upholding some lofty sense[n]of righteousness, leaving all his[n]responsibilities on us.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: A-All I was trying to say was—

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Isn't it about time you grew up and[n]acknowledged our situation!?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Right now, you're useless to me.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: All you do is eat away at my life.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: *sigh* Sorry, that was uncalled for.[n]I'm just... really tired.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...I'll be eating dinner out from[n]tomorrow on.
